# Write-back: the verified model in DataHub

After a model passes every gate, Groundskeeper registers it in the catalog
so the next person or agent inherits the work. Queried from a live DataHub
after `scripts/run_task.py --write-back`:

```json
{
  "dataset": {
    "urn": "urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:dbt,mart_revenue_by_region,PROD)",
    "properties": {
      "description": "total revenue and order count by region for the last 30 days\n\nGenerated by Groundskeeper and verified against the catalog (field existence, governance, and execution) in 1 attempt(s)."
    },
    "upstream": {
      "total": 3,
      "relationships": [
        {
          "entity": {
            "urn": "urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:dbt,b2fd91.order_entry_db.order_entry.orders,PROD)"
          }
        },
        {
          "entity": {
            "urn": "urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:dbt,b2fd91.order_entry_db.order_entry.regions,PROD)"
          }
        },
        {
          "entity": {
            "urn": "urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:dbt,b2fd91.order_entry_db.order_entry.customers,PROD)"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Upstream lineage points at the real source tables the SQL reads, derived
from the parsed query rather than declared by the model.
